svg.text: A horseshoe harbor: the town on the curve, cliffs and the lighthouse on the north horn, tide flats on the south; the liner beyond the mouth.

g.text: wreck camp · smugglers' cove · tide pools

svg.text: Open: the town is the hub and every district is a short walk
from Front Street; take them in any order. The bay is always
in view, the Lily lit up across the mouth: a promise all day.
Water at the centre makes long sightlines for gunfights.
the station at the town's east end
harbor master, chapel; out to docks, cliffs, beaches
Ned's rigged table in the Gilded Parlor
from the Lily's pier, across the bay
the side gangway, under the lights
